title: Dual-Quota Batch: A Common Independent Set with a Maximality Certificate
strategies: single-class trivial: fill Scheme A's classes to capacity in input order ignoring Scheme B, then repair by dropping whatever now breaks a Scheme-B quota
single-pass greedy: scan items in input order, add each item iff it keeps both quota systems feasible right now (no exchange, no certificate)
augmenting-path matroid intersection: repeatedly find an augmenting path in the exchange digraph and swap along it; when none exists, read the maximality certificate off the final reachable set
randomized multi-restart greedy over item orderings
